name: sakurafall
description: sakurafall - 多源番剧元数据与可替换开源片源驱动的 Electron 桌面客户端

scripts.dev: node scripts/kill-port.js && concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev:renderer" "wait-on tcp:5173 && npm run dev:electron"
scripts.clean:build: rimraf dist dist-app release artifacts tmp
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:electron: rimraf dist-app && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js && node scripts/create-release-manifest.js
scripts.build:dir: npm run build:renderer && rimraf dist-app && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.test: node --test tests/cms-api.test.js tests/title-matcher.test.js tests/bangumi-aliases.test.js tests/bangumi-network-fallback.test.js tests/anilist-fallback.test.js tests/share-page-resolver.test.js tests/http-client.test.js tests/playback-resolver.test.js tests/enhanced-player.test.js tests/source-health-score.test.js tests/update-checker.test.js tests/anime-database-cache.test.js tests/play-history-dedupe.test.js tests/continue-watching.test.mjs tests/anime-infinite-scroll.test.mjs tests/catalog-sort.test.mjs tests/episode-list.test.mjs tests/episode-metadata.test.mjs tests/episode-playback.test.mjs tests/playback-diagnostics.test.mjs tests/playback-frame-rate.test.mjs tests/player-media-session.test.mjs tests/hls-buffer-policy.test.mjs tests/hls-ad-markers.test.mjs tests/danmaku-api.test.js tests/danmaku-match.test.mjs tests/player-preferences.test.mjs tests/image-cache.test.js tests/media-library.test.js tests/subject-service-performance.test.js tests/subject-index-sort.test.js tests/subject-detail-coordinator.test.mjs tests/customization-pack.test.js tests/runtime-diagnostics.test.js tests/source-match.test.mjs tests/source-search-queries.test.mjs tests/source-provider-registry.test.js tests/theme-runtime.test.mjs tests/theme-packs-v2.test.mjs tests/performance-budget.test.mjs tests/xpath-rule-adapter.test.js tests/web-page-media-sniffer.test.js tests/ui-overlays.test.mjs tests/anime4k-webgl.test.mjs tests/anime4k-webgpu.test.mjs tests/bt-filename-parser.test.mjs tests/bt-stream.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run test:features && npm run test:video-proxy && npm run build:renderer && node --test tests/performance-budget.test.mjs
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify && npm run build && npm run smoke:packaged && npm run smoke:packaged:offline && npm run smoke:installer
